items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: I know he got Thad in the band, and maybe Snooky.

ctx.x: You mentioned Frank Wess and he had a pretty important role in the Basie band during his tenure didn’t he?

Oh, sure. I think he was responsible for a lot of people being there. I know he got Thad in the band, and maybe Snooky. I mean these are some of the most important people in the band and of course he played the flute. And this was totally unique in the whole Basie tradition. And the sound that he brought, his contribution. And he’s also another great arranger. I mean not just a good arranger, he’s a great arranger. And Frank Foster. I mean you ask Frank Foster who the best arranger in the band was, he always says…
There is one particular album I remember that they did with Frank Sinatra where Frank’s flute was so wonderful. He just played behind and added that great touch.
